question: (a) What do the ELR-40 magazine packages read, and does the site elr40 mag 8 follow the nominal + 1 convention of the other six bolt-actions? (b) What is the Mk 24 DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex and the head multiplier it selects? (g) Season 5 weapons: heat fields, class-trait membership and limb arrays.

serialized: (a) ELR-40 Std package WPM_MAG_Std_CDX40_W05 (the 7 Rnd default, reached through Attachment_CDX40_MAG_Regular -> U_PRG_CDX40_MAG_Regular -> CDX40_Ability branch -> selector in the package Field_819acc98): MagazineCapacity Field_7f22bfb4 = 8, NumberOfMagazines Field_4614adfe = 7, InitialAmmo Field_80a58418 = -1.
(a) Other ELR-40 packages: Compact1 (Single Shot) 1 / 49; Compact2 (5 Rnd) 6 / 8; Fast (7 Fast) 8 / 7 (capacity / NumberOfMagazines). CDX40_WB Ammo struct: 1 / 50.

(a) Other six bolt-actions: the shared default and Fast packages Magazine/WPM_MAG_Std_W05 and FastMagazine/WPM_MAG_Fast_W10 hold no Ammo struct; the WB Ammo capacity equals site mag and nominal + 1 on all six (M2010 ESR 6, SV-98 11, PSR 11, Mini Scout 11, L115 6, Interdictor 6). Non-default packages with an Ammo struct are nominal + 1 on every one (8 -> 9, 7 -> 8, 15 -> 16, 20 -> 21, 3 -> 4). DB-12 WB capacity 16 (nominal 14 + 2).

(b) MRGGA_WB DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex (Class_35259f6b Field_58d70acb Struct Field_9ba8b76b) = 12; base projectile PD_65x48mm packed material 0x1f002680 (material 496); head array for material 496 against head material 24 has 1.57 at index 12 and 1.4 at index 11 on both mp_abbasid and mp_badlands grids. M4A1_WB index 11, PD_556x45mmNATO_Carbine material 276, head 1.4.

(g1) The four Season 5 WB files carry the same OverHeat block as M250 (Field_43a8d9ab: HeatPerBullet 0, HeatDropPerSecond 0.2, OverHeatDropDelay 0, OverHeatPenaltyTime 3, OverHeatThreshold 0.8); M27IAR_WB reproduces the L35 values 0.0025 / 0.2 / 0 / 0 / 1.

(g2) Class-trait byte markers: MRGGA_WB holds the WM_AssaultTrait file GUID; CDX40_WB holds WM_ReconTrait and WPM_SwayPenalty; PKM_WB holds WPM_SupportTrait and GS_PKM the GID_ADSTime_Trait_P10 key 8430ed47; GS_RSAR999 holds the GDM_Array_HipDispersion_TRAIT key d821968e. Class counts across the 67 site weapons: 12 AR, 7 sniper, 11 LMG, 11 SMG, each the full site class.

(g3) Limb array (grid projectile material against limb material 26, equal to the abdomen array): Mk 24 0.84 (material 496), ELR-40 0.67 (PD_.375EnABELR_Match, material 290), Z84M 0.84 (PD_762x54mmR_MG, material 496), RSPR 0.84 (PD_762x39mm_PDW, material 493); M4A1 control 0.84. All equal data/hit_zones.json.
sourceFacts.control: Control first. (a) M2010 ESR default package must read MagazineCapacity = site mag 6: the join site choice 5_rnd -> Attachment_M2010ESR_MAG_Regular -> U_PRG -> Ability branch -> selector -> WPM_MAG_Std_W05 resolves, but that shared default package holds NO Ammo struct (Class_e7d2410a absent), so the default capacity is the M2010ESR_WB Ammo struct: 6 = site mag 6 (nominal 5 + 1). The same weapon's 8 Rnd package (WPM_MAG_008Ext1_M2010ESR_W25) reads 9 = 8 + 1. DB-12 default (WB, shared Std package, no Ammo struct) reads 16 = nominal 14 + 2. (b) M4A1 control: index 11 -> head 1.4 = site hit_zones m4a1 headshot 1.4. (g) controls: M27IAR_WB heat block reproduces the L35 values; class-trait byte markers reproduce the L100-L104 launch memberships (11 AR, 10 LMG, 10 SMG, 6 sniper) plus one new weapon each; M4A1 limb 0.84 = site.

inference: The ELR-40 WB Ammo block (capacity 1, 50 magazines) has the same capacity as the Single Shot package (1, 49 magazines) and is read as the bare receiver; the Std package then supplies the 7 Rnd magazine as nominal 7 + 1 chambered, the same relation as the other bolt-actions (inferred).

The default Std and Fast packages hold no Ammo struct on the six launch bolt-actions, so their effective capacity is read from the WB Ammo struct (inferred from the site convention; native composition not decoded).
Packages map to site choices by attachment name and nominal count.
Class-trait membership is inferred from raw GUID occurrences following the L100-L104 route; class traits remain unmodeled on the site.
Heat: HeatPerBullet 0 is read as no per-shot heat accumulation configured on the four weapons (stored value only).
unresolved: Native use of the default-package-without-Ammo-struct rule: the source shows the Std/Fast shared packages hold no Ammo struct; that the game then keeps the WB Ammo struct, and which Ammo struct a weapon uses once a package is applied, is not decoded (site convention treats the WB capacity as the default).
Meaning of NumberOfMagazines (50 on the CDX40 WB, 7 on the Std package) and InitialAmmo -1 remains unresolved (L110 convention).

Mapping of the four ELR-40 packages to site choices (7_rnd, 1_rnd, 5_rnd, 7_fast) is by attachment name and nominal count, not by a source label: Regular -> 7_rnd, Compact1 -> 1_rnd, Compact2 -> 5_rnd, Fast -> 7_fast.

Class-trait membership is a raw GUID byte occurrence (import table / GS binding key) plus the L100-L104 reading; native activation (class plus signature weapon) is not decoded. A byte match does not prove runtime use.
Heat: HeatPerBullet 0 is a stored value; whether any other source heats these weapons or what the OverHeat block does natively is unresolved (L35 limits).
Limb and head multipliers use the base projectile only; ammunition-attachment projectile swaps for the four weapons were not re-derived here (stage 9 B did).

Material grid reads use the repo bounded reader (frosty-hit-zones.py MaterialGrid) on two levels (mp_abbasid, mp_badlands); other levels were not read. Soldier bone materials (Head 24, Spine 25, limbs 26) are taken from the L99/hit-zone convention, not re-read.
siteImpact: No site change. (a) data/weapons.json elr40 mag 8 equals the source Std 7 Rnd package capacity 8 (nominal 7 + 1 chambered); WEAPON_MAG.elr40 default 7_rnd and its nominal values 1, 5, 7, 7 are the menu nominals. The WB value 1 (NumberOfMagazines 50) is the same capacity as the Single Shot package (1 / 49), read as the bare receiver. (b) data/hit_zones.json mk24 protectionIndex 12 and headshot 1.57 equal the source. (g) heat, class-trait membership and limb values for the four Season 5 weapons match the site (no heat in the model; class traits remain unmodeled, as for the launch weapons).
